name: SDiff

source.code:
/-- Notation type class for the set difference `\`. -/
class SDiff (α : Type u) where
  /--
  `a \ b` is the set difference of `a` and `b`,
  consisting of all elements in `a` that are not in `b`.
  -/
  sdiff : α → α → α
